title: Mystic Gate Aurora Ritual
description: A woman in a flowing dark blue robe kneels in an ancient stone ruin, casting a swirling rainbow spell from her hands toward a translucent glowing white wolf. Behind them stands a large ornate metal gate entwined with a massive tree under a vibrant purple and green aurora borealis in a starry night sky.
prompt: A woman in a long dark blue starry robe kneels among blue flowers in an ancient ivy-covered stone ruin, casting a swirling rainbow of light magic from her hands. A translucent glowing white wolf stands beside her while a large black raven flies nearby. Behind them is a grand ornate metal gate overgrown with a massive ancient tree under a dramatic purple and green aurora borealis filling the starry night sky, with glowing runes floating in the air.
